decisions.reason: Despite reduced online visibility, the citrus harvesting crate remains a strategic flagship for agricultural sustainability.
Foldable large containers are core to pooling and logistics operations, so drop probability remains low.
Stackable plastic crates are staple products with steady demand across multiple customer segments.
Medium-duty rackable pallets are standard in industrial and retail logistics, supporting continued retention.
Spill-retention pallets meet ongoing safety and environmental compliance requirements, justifying their place in the portfolio.
Plastic pallets with load retainers serve a specialized logistics niche aligned with the firm's reusable packaging focus.
